title: Mosques I manage
intro: Keep your mosque's site up to date: details, blog, pages and comments.
empty_title: You do not manage a mosque yet
empty_body: Find your mosque on the map, open its page and choose “Request to manage this mosque”.
empty_admin: As an administrator you can manage any mosque: open its page and choose “Manage this page”.
details_intro: What visitors see on the mosque's site: its look, its story and how to reach it.
logo_hint: A square picture: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 4 MB at most.
cover_hint: A wide picture shown at the top of the page, 4 MB at most.
jumua_intro: Times of the Friday prayer at your mosque.
jumua_as_dhuhr: Jumu'a is held at Dhuhr time
admin_fields_note: The mosque's name, address, position on the map and verification are handled by the Salat Time team. Write to us if they need correcting.
image_type: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture.
image_too_big: The picture is larger than 4 MB.
image_unreadable: This picture could not be read. Please try another file.
posts_intro: Khutbahs, news, events, lessons and announcements on the mosque's site.
no_posts_hint: Write a post to share news with your community.
delete_post_body: “{title}” and its comments will disappear from the mosque's page.
event_starts_at: Date and time of the event
post_body_hint: Markdown: headings, bold, italic, links, lists and quotes.
post_image_hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 4 MB at most. Location data is removed.
pin: Pin to the top of the page
pin_hint: Pinned posts stay above the others.
comments_intro: Hidden comments disappear from the public page but are kept for the record.
overview_intro: Where your mosque's site stands, and what to do next.
comments_summary: {total} comments in all · {recent} this week · {hidden} hidden
checklist_contact: Give a phone number or an email
shortcut_page: About us, courses, contact, opening hours…
shortcut_display: Prayer times full screen, for the prayer hall's TV.
shortcut_campaigns: Raise funds for a project, with an admin's approval.
shortcut_payouts: Where donations go: the mosque's own PayPal or IBAN.
section_identity_hint: Logo, cover, a short line under the name and the site's colour.
section_social_hint: A link or a handle (@name). Only addresses of each network are accepted.
tagline_hint: One short line under the mosque's name, e.g. “A house of prayer and learning since 1987”.
accent_hint: Used for the menu, buttons and highlights of the mosque's site.
accent_contrast_low: hard to read, choose a darker or lighter colour
accent_too_light: Very light: lines and icons in this colour will hardly show on a light background.
social_invalid: This is not a {network} address or handle.
categories_intro: Sort the blog's posts. Visitors filter the blog by category.
categories_note: Renaming a category keeps its address, so links to it keep working.
no_categories: No categories. Posts are shown together on the blog.
delete_category_body: “{name}” will disappear. Its {count} posts stay on the blog, without a category.
category_deleted: Category deleted. Its posts are kept.
categories_changed: The categories changed meanwhile. Please reload the page.
categories_full: A mosque can have up to {max} categories.
slug_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Leave empty to make it from the title.
excerpt_hint: One or two sentences shown on cards and in link previews.
video_hint: A YouTube or Vimeo link. It plays in their privacy-enhanced player, only when the visitor presses play.
video_invalid: Use a YouTube or Vimeo video link.
attachment_hint: The khutbah text or a programme: a PDF of {max} MB at most.
attachment_too_big: The file is larger than {max} MB.
attachment_unreadable: This file is not a readable PDF.
status_publish_now_hint: Visible on the site as soon as you save.
status_keep_published_hint: Stays on the site, with its original date.
status_schedule_hint: Goes public by itself at the time you choose.
status_draft_hint: Only the mosque's managers see it.
schedule_in_future: Choose a time that is still to come.
md_hint: Markdown formatting. HTML code is removed.
md_preview_failed: The preview could not be loaded. Your text is safe; try again in a moment.
pages_intro: Lasting pages of the site: About us, Courses, Contact, Opening hours…
no_pages_hint: Tell visitors who you are, the courses you offer and how to reach you.
delete_page_body: “{title}” will disappear from the mosque's site.
page_published_hint: Unpublished pages are visible only to the mosque's managers.
page_in_menu_hint: Pages outside the menu can still be linked to.
pages_full: A mosque can have up to {max} pages.
slug_taken: Another post or page took this address a moment ago. Please choose another one.
